overview.title: Energy
overview.description: How much electricity the house used, where it came from and what used it.

appliances.title: Appliances
appliances.description: Everything that uses electricity, by place. Measured appliances get their own share in the breakdown.

setup.title: Solar, battery & gas
setup.description: Your solar panels, home battery and gas connection. Needed to compute what the house really consumed.

import.title: Import data
import.description: Import the quarter-hour file from Mijn Fluvius, or enter meter readings by hand.

stats.selfSufficiencyHint: Share of use not bought from the grid
stats.selfConsumptionHint: Share of solar used at home

chart.title: Energy flow
chart.description: Above the line: where the energy the house used came from. Below: where surplus went.
chart.descriptionGridOnly: Above the line: taken from the grid. Below: injected into the grid.
chart.descriptionGas: Gas used for heating, hot water and cooking, in kWh.
chart.descriptionTotal: Electricity and gas the house used, together in kWh.

breakdown.title: Where it went
breakdown.description: Measured appliances get their share; everything else is Unknown.
breakdown.allUnknown: Nothing is measured yet, so all consumption is Unknown. Every smart plug or sub-meter you add makes this smaller.
breakdown.noConsumption: Consumption can't be computed for this period, so shares are not shown.
breakdown.noData: No consumption data in this period.
breakdown.label: Consumption per appliance

peak.title: Monthly peak
peak.description: Highest quarter-hour offtake this month. The capacity tariff bills at least 2,5 kW.
peak.minimum: Below the 2,5 kW minimum, billed as 2,5 kW
peak.none: No quarter-hour data for {{month}} yet. Import a Fluvius file to see your peak.

solarNotMeasured.title: Solar production is not measured
solarNotMeasured.description: The Fluvius file only shows what went through the meter. Without the production of your panels, consumption, self-sufficiency and the breakdown can't be computed. Enter inverter readings on the import page, or connect Home Assistant later.

batteryNotMeasured.title: The battery is not measured
batteryNotMeasured.description: Charge and discharge are needed to compute consumption. Enter battery readings on the import page.

notices.totalWithoutGas: No gas data in this period: the total is electricity only. Import the Fluvius gas file to add it.
notices.totalWithoutElectricity: No electricity data in this period: the total is gas only.

overview.title: No energy data yet
overview.description: Start by importing the quarter-hour file from Mijn Fluvius. Got solar panels? Add them first, so consumption can be computed honestly.

gas.title: No gas data yet
gas.description: Import the hourly gas file from Mijn Fluvius (Verbruikshistoriek → gas), or enter gas meter readings in m³.

documents.label: Documents
documents.description: Manuals, warranties and receipts for this appliance.

empty.title: No appliances yet
empty.description: Add the things that use a lot: heat pump, jacuzzi, EV charger, dryer… Link them to a place so you know where the energy goes.

form.description: Rated power is on the nameplate. It will be used to estimate unmeasured appliances later.
form.carriersHint: A gas boiler runs on gas and electricity (its pump); a gas hob on gas only.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.description: Its meters and measured data are deleted too.

place.empty: No appliances in this place yet

empty.title: No solar panels
empty.description: Add your installation (an east/west roof is two). Without it, the overview assumes there is no solar production.

form.description: One entry per roof face. Total peak power (kWp) is computed.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.description: Meters linked to these panels keep their data.

empty.title: No home battery
empty.description: Planning one? Add it with its installation date; it only counts from that day on.

form.description: Use the usable capacity from the datasheet.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.description: Meters linked to this battery keep their data.

drop.title: Drop your Fluvius file here
drop.description: Mijn Fluvius → Verbruikshistoriek → electricity (quarter-hour totals) or gas (hour totals) → download CSV. Electricity or gas is detected automatically; the file stays in your browser until you confirm.

preview.title: Ready to import
preview.skipped_one: {{count}} row could not be read and will be skipped.
preview.skipped_other: {{count}} rows could not be read and will be skipped.
preview.noRows: This file has no electricity rows to import.

done.title: Import finished
done.description: {{count}} intervals saved. Importing the same period again replaces the values, nothing is counted twice.

errors.header: This doesn't look like a Fluvius consumption file. Download the quarter-hour totals for electricity as CSV.
errors.read: The file could not be read.
errors.upload: The import stopped halfway. Try again: rows already saved are simply overwritten.
errors.uploadPartial: The import stopped at batch {{batch}} of {{batches}} ({{rows}} rows saved). Try again: rows already saved are simply overwritten.

stopped.title: Import stopped
stopped.description: Stopped after batch {{batch}} of {{batches}}. The rows saved so far stay; resume to save the rest (rows already saved are simply overwritten).

readings.title: Meter readings
readings.description: No digital meter export? Enter the register values from time to time; the difference between two readings becomes usage.
readings.gasHint: Converted to kWh with the calorific value from Solar, battery & gas.

meters.title: Data in WickedHome
meters.description: Each channel with its source and the period it covers.

gas.title: Gas
gas.description: Your gas connection. Gas use comes from the Fluvius gas file or from meter readings.
gas.calorificExplained: Gas meters count m³. One m³ holds about 11 kWh, depending on the gas: Fluvius files carry the exact value per hour; manual readings use the value above.

form.title: Gas connection
form.description: The EAN is on your energy bill. The calorific value turns manual m³ readings into kWh.
form.calorificHint: Gross calorific value, usually 11,0 – 11,6 kWh/m³ (see your bill or Fluvius).

loading.error: The energy figures could not be loaded.
